purpose: Authoritative rights record for every asset considered or produced during the feat/kaki-world-asset-overhaul wave. An asset may not enter assets/ unless it has a GREEN row here.

gate.rule: Only GREEN assets may enter the production repository.
gate.green: Explicitly permits transformation, interactive-game inclusion, public hosting, redistribution, commercial use, and continued inclusion after modification.
gate.yellow: Downloadable but redistribution/derivative/commercial rights unclear. Private ignored staging only. Never shipped, never committed, never screenshotted for promotion.
gate.red: Terms prohibit the intended use, permission refused, inseparable protected branding, or rights unverifiable. Not used and not recreated.

bimobjectDetermination.appliesTo: every product on bimobject.com, without exception, for this project
bimobjectDetermination.consequence: No BIMobject geometry, texture, material, or measurement enters this repository. All seven planned world kits are original clean-room work built by committed Blender builders.

accessMethodNote.finding: A scripted downloader that targets BIMobject's internal /proxy/product-api-with-user endpoint exists on the build workstation from unrelated prior work.
accessMethodNote.ruling: Not used for this wave and prohibited from future use for this project. The wave brief forbids reverse-engineering private download APIs, and EULA 4.7(a) and 4.7(h) prohibit non-interface access and deriving non-public APIs.

preExistingThirdPartyAssets.note: Assets already shipping in Kaki Rally before this wave are unchanged and retain their existing rights basis. This wave introduces no new third-party source and removes none. See CREDITS.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the authoritative record.
